title: Graduate program application
description: Choose the graduate qualification and program, then use the official CGS application link.
descriptionAr: حدد درجة وبرنامج الدراسات العليا ثم استخدم رابط التقديم الرسمي لكلية الدراسات العليا.
verificationNote: Use the current official page for portal labels, applicable term and eligibility. This checklist does not submit a request or verify your private university record. A linked historical admission-cycle table does not establish a later intake deadline.
verificationNoteAr: تحقق من المسميات والفصل والأهلية في الصفحة الرسمية الحالية. لا ترسل هذه القائمة الطلب ولا تتحقق من سجلك الجامعي الخاص.
scopeNote: A linked historical admission-cycle table does not establish a later intake deadline.

steps.title: Choose the degree and program
steps.instruction: Choose the degree and program: read its general and program-specific admission requirements.
steps.instructionAr: حدد الدرجة والبرنامج: اقرأ شروط القبول العامة والشروط الخاصة بالبرنامج.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.instruction: Apply online: open the official Apply link on the CGS admissions page and provide the documents required for that qualification.
steps.instructionAr: قدّم إلكترونياً: افتح رابط التقديم الرسمي في صفحة القبول وأرفق مستندات الدرجة المطلوبة.

steps.title: Check the intended intake
steps.instruction: Check the intended intake: meeting minimum requirements does not guarantee admission; ask the college or PG@uaeu.ac.ae about the applicable program and intake.
steps.instructionAr: تحقق من الفصل المطلوب: استيفاء الحد الأدنى لا يضمن القبول؛ استفسر من الكلية أو PG@uaeu.ac.ae عن البرنامج والفصل المعني.

sources.title: UAEU College of Graduate Studies Admission
sources.sourceSection: Masters requirements and conditional admission; PhD requirements and Required Documents for PhD programs
sources.evidenceText:
Graduate application and requirements
- Apply through the official online link on the College of Graduate Studies admission page after choosing the degree and program. Program standards can be higher; meeting minimums does not guarantee admission.
- For a predominantly English-taught master's, the general baseline is a related accredited bachelor's degree, GPA 3.0/4.0 and IELTS Academic 6.0. IELTS 5.5 is a conditional route, not automatic eligibility: reach 6.0 by the end of the first semester, take at most 6 credit hours initially (excluding intensive English), and earn GPA 3.0 in the first 9 credit-bearing hours. Separate conditional GPA routes exist from 2.5; Arabic-taught master's programs list IELTS 4.0.
- General PhD minimums are master's GPA 3.0, bachelor's GPA 2.5, and IELTS 6.5 for English-medium study/English dissertation; Arabic-medium PhD lists IELTS 5.0. Language-test exemptions and additional college requirements may apply.
- PhD document checklist: certified bachelor's and master's degree certificates and transcripts; Ministry of Education equivalency/certificate recognition for the previous degree as required; English proficiency certificate; Arabic proficiency certificate for Arabic-medium PhD; two recommendation letters; CV; valid passport for all applicants, plus Emirates ID for UAE residents and family book for UAE nationals; and a personal photo. Passport and ID are not interchangeable alternatives.
